# The splits of a_usd_card_charged_and_refunded_in_one_transaction.txt, the
# refund written first.
#
# Read in the file's order, the refund would take the card owing nothing to a
# credit of 100.00, and the charge then across zero to owing 50.00: 100.00
# held brought in, then 100.00 of it spent and 50.00 owed. What each split
# brought in is read the same whichever order the file gives.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Liabilities:USD Card 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "140.00"
	Liabilities:USD Card -150.00 USD
